title: Wrochna's graph formulation of the index conjecture
statement:
Let $G$ and $H$ be graphs, let $\Omega_{2d+1}(G)$ denote the graph functor used in the source, and let $n$ be a positive integer. **Wrochna's graph-index conjecture.** If 
$$
\chi(G\times H)\le n,
$$
 then for some integer $d$, $\Omega_{2d+1}(G)$ or $\Omega_{2d+1}(H)$ is $n$-colourable. This is equivalent in the source to Wrochna's index conjecture for $\mathbb{Z}_2$-spaces and is presented as open.
source_name: Xuding Zhu, “A survey on Hedetniemi's conjecture”, arXiv:2502.16078 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.16078

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2025).
